description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data across three years, 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart is divided into three slices, each corresponding to a specific year. The slice for 2019 is blue and occupies approximately 46% of the chart, although the percentage is not directly labeled, the proportion is indicated by the numerical value (46) within the slice. The 2018 slice is orange, labeled with 33.0%, and corresponds to the numerical value (33). The 2017 slice is green, labeled with 21.0%, and corresponds to the numerical value (21). The chart does not include a legend, but the year labels are placed outside the chart next to their respective slices. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order from largest to smallest, with 2019 being the largest, followed by 2018, and then 2017. None of the slices are visually emphasized.
